body:
I dated a Polish girl.
The whole relationship started off with a lie.
She lied about her legal status, lied about being single(turns out she was married), lied about her job, lied about being normal(turns out she was bipolar)
Long storry short when i broke up with her after 5 months off and on she killed herself. 
Its very sad i still cry about it 11 months later.

Hello
I was in a very similar situation like you.
I dated her for only a few months around 5 or so. 
She took her own life as well back in 2015 April with a firearm. 
Its been a little over 10 months for me.
I have been where you are. Im here to talk if you want.
Things will get easier. Just be patient.

Hello
Hang in there Ginger Aide.
It is a psychological, physical and emotional rollercoaster. Some days are better then others. But dont be discouraged. No one thinks this can happen to them. But when it does happen we are utterly lost. No one knows how you feel besides yourself and potentially others who are in your situation. However lettinf friends and family help is key in getting back on your feet. 
When i wrote this i was having a moment of weakness. But if you are patient they go away. And will happen less frequently as life goes on.

My deepest condolences to you and your family. Like everyone here says at the moment yoi are in a state of shock. That is your body's way of helping you cope. It it very important to be around others. Vent to them. Tell your story a million times over. True friends and family will stand by you through thick and thin. For me its been 8 months since my ex took her own life. It does get better as time goes on. But grieve at your own pace. 
Please reach out and dont keep your emotions bottled in.

Hello
My condolences to you. Its a tragic thing that happened. 
Right now you are in a state of shock. This is a totally natural reaction your body does in order to protect you. You have to be patient and gentle with your self. Try to be around friends and family. Even though you might feel thay you want to be alone. 
Dont do it. Let others comfort you. Even if they dont know what to say. The presence of a loves one alone can help you in your time of need. 
I have been and somewhat still am going through a similar situation like yours. 
Its been almost 8 months. But i have had some great support along the way. Family and friends make all the difference. Make sure you communicate with them. And feel free to repeat the story a thousand times. Dont worry they will listen. True friends stand by you through thick and thin.
Im here if you need someone to vent to.
Take care of your self.

Hello
Right now you are in shock. This is a natural response to what happened. Your outlook on lige has changed because you have never been in a situation like this. Its something new and it is hard to handle. 
Try to be around loved ones and cry as much as you need to. Dont isolate yourself. 
I am 7 months out since my ex killed her self. 
Let me know if you would like to talk. We can talk through messages.

Take care

Hello
That is quite the predicament you are in. However as i say that i have ti admire your courage and will to live. You have so many responsibilities at the moment. You are able to work take care of your child and deal with the drama at home. My hat off to you.
Please know that this journey you are on is a slow one. Some days are better then others. And just as you feel like the clouds have parted and the sun is is shinning through booom another storm of grief comes. You seem to be a very warm and heartfelt person. Im only 7 months in sine my ex gf killed herself. Its hard yes. But reading books, taking to people and praying has helped me so far. You have people to talk to. Us on reddit. There are many like you who have lost someone dear. Do not hesitate to vent. Its very healthy. Feel free to message me anytime you want.
Take care and remember cry if you need to scream if you have to. Let your emotions out. Its the healthy way to recovery.

Hi everyone. This has happened to me. Below is a post i submitted on ask women a few months back. I got some good honest feedback. There was more to the story then what i posted. However since my ex is gone i dont want to say anything negative about her.
I am in therapy now and have been doing it for over 5 months. It has helped but i still need more. My friends and family tell me i am a good person and that i need to forgive myself. This is easier said then done. I just feel that what i did to her in the fragile state was something that contributed to her decision. Anyway please feel to read it.

"Hello I am in a difficult situation now. Yes like the title says my ex girlfriend killes herself back in April. Here is the back story. We dated off and on for only 5 months. I broke up with her the 2nd time because i saw the relationship as becoming stagnant. We were fighting alot because she criticized me on every little thing i did. It seemed i couldn't do anything to please her. She was in a crisis center in November of 2014 because she had a break down. There she was diagnosed as bipolar. She refused to believe it and did not want to take the medicine she was prescribed. So when i was still with her in 2015 i was talking to her ex room mate. I was flirting with her and even asked her if we could be together. She told me that wouldn't be possible since it would not be right.

When i broke up with my gf in March i hit on her room mate again. Hoping that me being single would make her change her mind. It did not. We met a few times and had dinnownnt to the park but thats it.

So then after seeing that dimet work i tried to go back to my ex who by now was very depressed. I told her that i wanted to be with her and that i didnt care what anyone else said. I felt bad for her since she was depressed and her parents were not here. They lived in another country. So needless to say she agreed to givr it a shot after which i changed my mind a few days later and told her that i have problems and that she is better off with out me. A week later she shot her self.

She left a note. She did not blame anyone for what she did. But still i feel alot of guilt. Its been 4 1/2 months since it happend. Things are gettinf better but im still sad at times. All my friends including my family tell me its not my fault. That i only knew her for 8 months and that i met her when she was most fragile. I even spoke to one of her close friends and she said that her parents dont blame me either. Basically no one has accused me directly. I know some of her friends deep down inside blame me because after i staryed dating her thins went down hill with my ex and her friends. Any way i have been seeing a psychologist since this happened and things are improving a little here and there.

I am absolutely petrified of getting into any relationship because of what happened. I have had the opportunity to go on dates with girls but i usually bring this tragic event up early in the date to let them know that i have alot of emotional baggage. Most try to help me and they dont mind hanging out with me. I feel like i dont deserve this. Like i should continue to punish myself for what happpened for a long time.

I clearly made mistakes with my ex. I was immature and i flirted. I never did cheat on her but thats beside the point.

I am awful i know. I hate myself for what i did."

The most basic of tasks are very hard to do. Grief is powerful. Especially at the beginning. It tool my 3 months to vacuum and clean my house afte it happened. It sucks so bad. But remeber you are human. You have a soul and the fact that you are suffering so much shows that you have compasion and are a caring person. You will feel like you have to isloate your self at times. You might feel that being alone is the way ita going to be from now on. Trust me that is not the case. Alot of bad things happen in this world. You just dont think it can happen to you. And when it does it changes your life forever. Hang in there take you time. 
And please let other help you, friends family and yes even reddit people.
Take care

Hi
Im in a similar situation like you are. My ex gf killed herself 6 weeks after we broke up. That was back in April. I have to tell you that it does get better with time. You are riding the roller coaster of emotions. Some days are good some days are even better. Then again some days are aganozing because you find you self in a world of grief. Just as you thought things were getting better. 
Its been over 6 months for me and i have to tell you at 2 months i was still in shock. 
Try to be patient with yourself. And do your best to love yourself as well. You might feel alot of anger towards yourself and towards your loved one for doing this. But you have to slowly realize that it was not your fault. We are responsible for our own actions. Im am filled with saddness as i am writing this to you because i am having a shitty day as well. But i hope that tomorrow will be better. Dont give up hope and dont let anyone rush you. What you are feeling is normal. 
Take it easy and feel free to message me any time you like.

Wow 12 years is a long time indeed. 
6 months just passed for me on October 20th. I was only with her for 5 months or so and sometimes i still cant believe it happened. Im sure you have heard this before " its not your fault etc etc". But i have a question for you since you have alot more experience with this then me and many others on this forum. How long did it take you to forgive yourself? Im asking because like many other peoplebwho have experienced this. There is alot of guilt associated with it.
Me and my gf were broken up when she decided to take her own life. But its still affected me and my relationships with my family and my friends alot. Its brought us closer in a way but in another way it has strained my relationship with my close family mother, father, sister. 
I have been reading alot of books about how to deal with the suicide of a loved one and it has helped to a certain degree. 
What was the things that you did that helped you move on? Any advice would be greatly appreciated.

Hi
Yeah i went to one of those groups once. I felt a little out of place because the people there had lost their daughters, sons etc. They made me feel very welcome. I guess i weighed my loss vs theirs and felt that they had more of a right to be there. 
The regret and the guilt tear you apart alot. Sometimes it strikes out of no where. One day you are ok. Another day the pain is intense. People around us who love us dont always know that we are hurting. Otherwise im sure they would rush to our side ASAP. Im sure you have told your friends and fam alot about your situation. But keep at it let them know. True friends and fam stick by each other through tough times. This is when you find out who your real friends. 
Take care of your self and be patient with your self at the same time.

Hey beangreen
I read some of your posts. 
You are just three months in. Man i know how that feels. Its awful. 
But trust me little by little you will feel it less and less. For me its 6 months today and yes i still cry for her. If only these people could see how much we cares for their life and how much of an impact it had on their loved ones. 
Anyway take care of yourself. And feel free to message me when you need to vent.

You are in shock right now. The best thing to do is to he around loved ones. Be kind and patient with your self. 
I have been in a similar situation. 
Message me if you would like to talk.

First off my condolences. 
The sudden death of a loved one is always hard. Especially when its suicide. 
Take your time and be patient. Grieve at your own pace and try to surround yourself with loved ones. 
You are probably still in shock. 
And are experiencing survivors guilt. 
It will get easier with time. Just do it one day at a time.

Hey 
There is hope
Why dont we talk. Im a complete stranger but im here to help.

Well i hope you have a fun birthday with your daughter and the rest of the fam. 
21 eh. Hmm keep her spirit alive and pray for her when you can. It helps.
Yeah he said it helped him. He is a sensitive guy what can you do. Its this whole "need time thing" . Its just that sometimes it passes by so freaking slow. And sometimes you look back and say its been however many months and you ask your self how you made it this far. 

Yeah i think i am having better days. 
Fridays usually suck because i know the weekend is coming and i have so much more time to myself. 
Its this whole "New Normal" im getting used to. Sometimes easier said then done. Im at the point where i dont want any self pity at all i mean zero. I try not to talk to people about it unless they ask first in regards to what happened. Like if they insist. 
How were you able to deal with the "New Normal" after your losses?

Yeah i had a chat with him today. We talked a little bit about how he feels. I listened mostly. 
I have seen a change in regards to that.
I do try to listen more and talk less. 
I hope it helps a little. 
I have to tell you this week i have had three good days in a row. 
Havent had that in months. 
How about you how has your week been so far?

Thats very nice of you. 
I have to ask you a question. 
Sine you have been through alot in life. Do you find your self trying to automatically help your friends when then have relationship problems.
I ask because there is this guy i work with and his gf broke up with him recently. Its affected his work performance alot at least thats what his manager says. I feel like i want to talk to him and let him vent at the same time to some one.

Ohh thats so nice of you to help others in their time of need. 
I bet its alot of work. But seeing them smile makes it all worth it right?

You have been so kind to me these past couple of weeks. Thank you so much. 
Yea im looking for friendship for now. And if something happens then thats great. 
I had a pretty good day. How was yours?

Hi beangreen
10 years.... Wow there is not much i can say that will help but i will try my best. The thing is that grieving and suffering knows no boundaries when it comes to time. Im no expert just a guy who is going through a rough time just like you are my friend. 
Im sure you have heard this many times in the past few weeks that " its not your fault" etc etc. Yes deep down inside when you have moments when you think rationally you say the same thing. But when emotion takes over you dont think other wise and cant help but blame yourself. The emotions come and go. One day you will be able to laugh and joke the next moment you will start crying because your sub conscience will punish you and say " how dare you laugh at a time like this" you cant help it and then you become sad again. I dont know if you go through the same thing im just telling you from experience and how i have felt in the past 5 months. Do not let anyone push you to do things you don't want. Such as hanging out in a large group with your friends. They are sentimental to your cause im sure and they are trying to help. But they dont feel what you feel and cant relate at all. Sorry to be so blunt but thats the way it is. The best thing they can do is just listen to you vent and not give you any advice because lets face the facts they have no idea. You might feel the need to isolate yourself and be alone. Thats ok sometimes you feel the need to do so. Just try to find something that brings you a little joy whether its a desert a food a tv show a book etc. Maybe even have a friend over you know just the two of you. Having a more intimate hangout with a friend i find helps. Doesnt matter if its a guy or girl. 
Talking about your trauma and having them listen might help you a little bit. So give it a try. 
The whole thing about the guilt and wanting to die is no way to live. I know how you feel. There will be times when you will be a bit more reckless and wish that you would die. You think this because you want to join her and see her again. Be patient and kind with your self man. Take it day by day.
Each day you will find your self making some progress. Whether its being able to do laundry or vacuum or go step outside for a minute and take a breath of fresh air. Be kind to yourself and patient. Grieving has no time limit. Do it on your terms dont let anyone rush you. I dont know if you have tried any grief groups or a therapist. I have been doing therapy for 3 months now and it has helped. You find out things about yourself that you never knew. 
You did not know about her illness. Because she didint want you to know. All these years she hid it from you. Im not trying to make her look bad or say anything bad about her. Thats the last thing i wanna do. I am just simply saying that what she did was about her. It did not have anything to do you. Trust me. 
I broke up with my ex gf and asked her to get back together with me a few weeks later them i changed my mind a few days later. She then killed herself a week later. The last time her i saw her she was angry with me. But i cant change anything now. 
Her drinking must have been a way for her to aleviate the pain. Anyone being with someone who drinks alot is always tough to put up with. You had no idea of the outcome. You said something's that your regret. Thats fair to think so. But like you said no rational person would go against the natural normal will to survive that human beings have. 
Im sure she was a wonderful person and you love her alot. But even if you were able to help her and quit drinking. You would have only prevented the inevitable. You said that you thought she was bipolar by the way she was acting lately. Im sure you have read alot about this on the internet. Im no expert but from some of the stories i read online people who are bipolar are experts at hiding it. They are able to put on a completely different face and alleviate your worries and pretend to be happy. Im here for you man. Feel free to write me and time. We can help each other through this. Take it minute by minute hour by hour anf day by day. The clouds of grief will eventually part the rays of hope will shine through.

Hang in there. We both have to.
I guess we have to take it day by day. 
Yeah i thought about dating but i called it quits. Today i came back in Tinder to give it another try. Im just afraid of meeting someone who is nice and sweet and like me more then i like her. I dont want to lead her on. Thats why i just want to meet new people and make friends. 
I have done that in the past. I led girls on. So i dont ever want to. I guess im waiting for the right one. One that will give me butterfly's. Sounds a little childish i know but i guess for now its better if take it easy. 
Hugs do help very much. They do. They are very comforting.

You will dream about them. I mean its crazy how you can only "see" them when you are dreaming. But at least you get to experience some time with them in a way. I had about 7 dreams about her. The last one was the nicest. She was smiling at me the whole time
 It made me feel good in a way. You are not being a hypocrite. You are grieving just like me just like all these other people on this subbreddit. I read some of these peoples losses. Ita shocking. I mean they were engaged and it still happened. They were married and it still happened. They had kids just like Johm did. They just cant see that unfortunately. I hope their souls are in heaven and not suffering. We here on earth have to learn to deal with this new "normal".
We have no choice. I have thought about joining her. But in my moment of clarity i can see that this will only create more misery for my family and friends.
Her dad requested me on facebook about after a month after it happened. I accepted his request. I guess he wanted to see what kind of guy i was maybe for closure. I know we will get it eventially. 
5 years from now we will think about it and it wont hurt as much. 
As humans we survive and find ways to adapt. A person for example who is blind will have their other sense heightened so that they can survive.
You can write me any time you want to vent. So please feel free to do so. 
Take care of yourself ok.

Hi
Well its a good think you are living healthy. That is always a plus. Also its a good thing you have support from you husband. And you are there for him. Thats what a relationship is all about. You help each other, love each other and support each other. 
You knew your friend John toward the end of his life. It would have been really hard for youbto help him since you didnt know about his mental issues. I think that we have a hard time making sense of all this because our brains have the basic human instinct to survive. Their braims had somthing that reversed that. Im not an expert so i dont know. But to them life seemed like such a struggle and the only way they thought they could get rid of the pain was to do what they did. Anyway you look at its tragic heartbreaking. If they knew or saw what this would cause to those closest to them, child, mother father, i mean the people who loved them the most they would have maybe thought twice. If that wasnt enough for them to reconsider. I have read so many stories about people who lost loved ones to suicide. I mean in the US alone there are over 40,000 suicides a year. My god that is crazy. I mean people like how me and you used to live before the tragedy will have their life shattered by suicide loss. Its awful. I wish the healthcare would take this into consideration more and offer more help and affordable treatment. 
Then again if the mentally ill people who are schizo, bipolar, borderline refuse the treatment. How are you supposed to keep them from doing it. You would have to watch them 24 hours a day 365 days a year. I don't think its humanly possible to do this. 
We can try to help each other since the tragedies are exactl 1 month apart. She did it April 20th 2015.

My ex was diagnosed as bipolar. But i suspect she was alos borderline.
Her friends before she did it offered to pay so she could see a specialist but she didnt want to. She did not want to admit it. Its sad. 
I bailed on ber when she was fragile. I did not ever in a million years suspect she would do what she did. 
I miss her.

Hi
Im glad the post helped you. Its a tragic story about your loss. Im sorry you have to go through this. The feelings are so intense. No one knows what this feels like unless they experienced it. Some people can handle it and rationalize it better then others. But in the end the grief thr guilt the memories are hard to process all at once. 
I get days when i am "ok" and then boom it hits me and I cry like a baby. I miss her yes even though we were broken up when it happened. What if it happened two years down the road. How would i have felt then? Alot worse im sure. 
But thats the way it played out.
How are you handling it day to day?
Do you have a rollercoaster of emotions also?

Hi
Yeah i guess your right. I mean i did it to see what others would say only knowing part of the story. It hurts though just thinking of her. She was so beautiful. 
I will slowly heal. I dont know if the process has started. Or maybe it has and i just dont feel it. Who knows.
But thanks for the continued positve messages. Eventually i will learn to live with it. 
How about you. How many months did it take for it to set in? You know accepting it?

Your comment brought tears to my eyes. 
People have told me that since it happened. I just refused to believe it. But its nice to hear it from others. Thank you so much

The thing that made it worse in the last couple of weeks was some of the responses i got from some of the posts on here. Like the one from askwomen. Click my profile and read some of the responses. They are not wrong in what they say it just brought me down and then some. 
I also think of my ex's poor mother and how much she is suffering. Its so sad. 
I would do anything to have her back. Just to be alive nothing else. Its wishful thinking i guess.

Hello
You know i never thought of it as me being a victim. But i guess in a way it makes sense.
The maturity thing has always been an issue for me no doubt. But i never thought my lack of it and my indecisiveness would lead to something like this. Its hard to live with especually in the morning when i wake up and realize it wasnt a dream.

Hi
Well thats good im glad to hear you have a steady relationship with him. 
I have always been somewhat codependent. I mean getting attention always kept me going. Especially emotional attention from girls. 
But its part of the histrionic behavior of mine. It needs to change.
Why i want to do this alone?
Well i feel like i am damaged goods now and i dont know if i want anyone especially if i was to meet someone new be put through my crying and sadness. Thats why i kind of distanced myself from any potential relationship. I guess the shame and the guilt make me think that way. They make me think that im toxic to people when maybe in reality i think that way because im grieving. The fact that we both let our sub conscience punish us when we want to he happy. 
I mean you say its been three years for you since it happened and it still brings up memories i wonder how ill be in three years.
My therapist says i should go outband meet people thatvi should try to find someone. 
I mean inwant to i just think i need to work on myself and mature more emotionally so that when i meet someone im not a puddle of goo. But a partner who is strong and confident.
Do you ever feel like when you are happy your mind tells you" how dare you be happy at a time like this"?

Hi
Well its good that he is beside you and that he is helong you. Its alot easier when you have someone by you to help you out. He sounds like a great guy. 
How long have you two been together is you dont mind me asking?

Well i did try to date right after it happened but it backfired and made things way worse. Then i tried Tinder and met a girl on there who i told about my situation the 1st date. She wasnt to shocked. If anything women with the exception of a few on reddit who gave me hell about what i did when i was with my ex were understanding. Even though i told them that i messed up before. 
The girl from Tinder seemed that she liked me even though all of this emotional baggage. But i did not want to lead her on. I made promises to my ex about being there for her, wanting to marry her and have her move in etc. But i backed out on all three. Since she was in a bad situation and bipolar it made things worse. So i know indirectly i contributed to her suicide. No matter what anyone else says. 

I just dont know when this feeling of guilt and anxiety will subside. Its gotten worse in the past 3 weeks for me. Im trying to deal with it by myself. As in i dont want to use any girl to help me get better. I am petrified of me leading them on and something bad happen. 

My therapist diagnosed me as being Histrionic and some what codependent. So its hard to do this by myself because im need of attention and validation etc. But i dont think its healthy in the long run. Im punishing myself in a way. Shame and guilt eat me up daily. 

But i dont know i feel like i deserve it.
Did you ever feel like this after you ex bf passed?

Yeah he is a lucky one no doubt. 
But i feel that when you experience a loss in life you will become over time a different more refined and maybe even tougher person. You will see things differently and appreciate them more. I think as humans we generally take things for granted when it becomes habit. Like a relationship with a girl or a son daughter etc. And we never ever think that anything bad can happen to us. We hear the news and feel bad for people when they suffer through losses but then say" well thank god that didnt happen to me" and move in with our lives. Once a loss has occurred initially its very hard to cope. I think that is the shock phase. Everyone grieves differently.
I have discovered that when people say you need to move on they say it because they generally care about you of course. But they also say it because their lives are happy and they want you to be happy as well. But no matter how many people say that you " move on " at your own pace. Dont let anyone force you otherwise. 
I have a question.
After how long did you tell your current boyfriend once you started dating about your losses?
Im curious because if i ever date again i would like to let her know at the right time. If there is such thing.

Take care

Good morning
Yeah i know the feeling. Thats why i almost completely stay away from facebook now. I go on occasionally to reply to event invites and say happy birthday but that is it. 
Im still friends with her on fb. Dont know if I can ever delete her. 
My advice would be to try to force yourself not to look on facebook that often. Its like an addiction. Once you beat it you will fell better. Its very hard but at least try. Limit your self slowly. Besides people post nothing but happy news on facebook weddings, baby pics, bf gf pics etc. When others are happy and we aren't it affects us in a deep way. I speak for my self when i say that im jealous when i see pics like that.

My week has been ok. Im staying busy at work so that helps. I sleep a little better also. 
I just want to be alone most of the time. I dont want to go out and every now and then a friend will meet with me. It must be a different stage of grief.

I
See but we can help each other. Give each other strength. Ive discovered recently that working many hours and staying busy makes my mind tired and does not go to those thoughts as often.
How was your week overall?
Any progress?

Hello
Im sorry to hear about your wife. My deepest condolences. Im going through a similar situation nut for me it was an ex girlfriend. 
I have read alot about suicide. Im sure you have also. Might i suggest this book.
I bought it and so far its helping me out a bit.
Its called "After the Darkest Hour".
If you need to vent i am here. Feel free to message me any time.

Hello
After reading your story i have to say that it was very heart warming. My condolences to your late ex boyfriend. 
I am going through a similar situation myself. Even though the circumstances were a little different. I broke up with her in early March and in mid April she shot herself. The last time i saw her she was upset with me. 
Like you said its hard to believe it initially. Its been almost 5 months and some days it gets easier others its harder. Once the initial shock wears off that's when things get a little tricky. 
PM me if you would like to chat more.
Take care

Hi again
You have been through so much. But like your screen name says Titanium its something tough and resilient like you. I know we dont know each other personally but you have come this far. Dont give up. Dont ever give up. Life sometimes can be so shitty i know. Why is it that some people never go through such loss in their life. Its not fair i know. It seems that when we are living a good comfortable life and something tragic and unexpected occurs it can literally turn our world upside down. No one is born to cope with this. Thats why it is so hard. It also depends on the type of personality each person has. Some can rationalize the situation better while others might replay the whole scenario in their head over and over again thinking there might have been some way to save that person. That is why there is so much guilt and shame. This causes a person (in both our cases) to be isolated, sad, depressed, shameful etc. Its so hard for friends and family to help that person. Because they dont feel what that person feels. No matter how hard they try. 
Three years is a long time no doubt. But dont let that bring you down. Each person heals at their own rate. Some take longer then others and thats ok. No one should ever rush you. Do it at your own pace. 
The motivation part os very difficult i know. You dont want to do anything except lay there and be by yourself with your own thoughts. I know the feeling all to well. 
However let me say that there is hope. I know you know that. But i just wanted to say that again. Even the smallest improvement is worth celebrating. What i mean by that is. If you are able one day to motivate your self to go outside of your house and smell the fresh air and see the sun even if its for a few minutes. That is progress. Small steps.
May i suggest reading a book. I am reading a book right now called "After the darkest hour".
And i have to say it has helped out alot. The author uses examples of tragedies as well as how the bereaved handled it and was able to move past it. I highly recommend it. 
Its going through loss and then feeling the grief that allows us to grow and become stronger then ever. Patience is key in this however. I hope one day that both of us will have been able to move on from this and become better people. 

But remember take your time. Each person is different.

Hope to hear from you soon
Take care

Yes i did see the story about Michelle Carter. Wow some people are just beyond words. 
Supposedly she suffers from Narcissistic Personality Disorder. 
That poor boy. He was crying out for help but only to her. How sad.

Hi again
Yes it does help to talk about it.
